source_metadata.exact_title: Pharmacokinetics of Intraperitoneal Cefalothin and Cefazolin in Patients Being Treated for Peritoneal Dialysis-Associated Peritonitis

findings: Drug assignment was physician-selected rather than randomized; comparative PK findings are preserved as observed group comparisons, not causal treatment effects.
The MIC=8 mg/L target and T>MIC findings are pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic surrogate evidence, not direct clinical efficacy outcomes.
The single-dose study cannot establish repeated-dose cefazolin accumulation or the efficacy of alternative cefalothin regimens.

schema_gaps: The schema has no dedicated pharmacokinetic-parameter object; PK endpoints are represented as quantitative_result atoms with surrogate outcomes.
A single quantitative_result requires one estimate, so plasma and intraperitoneal T>MIC percentages for cefalothin are represented as separate atoms.
extraction_limitations: Bibliography entries are excluded from evidence atoms and reconciled separately.
The study reports small nonrandomized groups (8 cefalothin; 11 cefazolin).
The supplement adds assay detail and future-research statements but no independent enrolled population.
